title: Cash Pickup Correction Guarantee: Days for Earlier Name Corrections
content:
**Training note: earlier corrections and the correction guarantee.**

**What is the correction guarantee?** It is the number of days of collection that a recipient-name correction on a Cash Pickup transfer guarantees the recipient.

**How do earlier corrections count?** The name corrections already recorded on the transfer before the present one add days to the guarantee.

| Name corrections recorded on the transfer before this one | Days added to the correction guarantee |
|---|---|
| two or more | 21 |
| exactly one | 14 |
| none | none |

**Is the present correction counted?** No. Only corrections recorded before it count.

**Hypothetical cases.**
- The first correction on a transfer: none before it, so no days.
- The second correction: one before it, so 14 days.
- The third correction: two before it, so 21 days.
